Why we own it Why we own ASML is the sole supplier of one of the most critical tools in the entire global semiconductor supply chain. Specifically, ASML is a capital equipment company with a dominant position in deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machines and sole manufacturer of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines. Gross margin of 54% exceeded the 51-53% guided range. Net income rose 26% year-over-year to €2.9B (basic EPS of €7.59).
